audience: accounting offices and companies that use SaldeoSMART to organize financial records

useCases.title: Find a company and its contractors
useCases.text: The AI lists companies available to your Saldeo user, then reads the selected company’s suppliers and customers, including VAT numbers, contact details and payment terms.

useCases.title: Review documents from a monthly folder
useCases.text: The AI lists document IDs from a company’s month folder, grouped by type, and retrieves selected documents for review. Large sets can be read in batches of up to 200 IDs.

useCases.title: Find a document by number or VAT number
useCases.text: The AI searches a company’s documents using a document number, VAT number, document ID or GUID and returns matching records. Multiple criteria narrow the search together.

useCases.title: Review sales invoices marked for export
useCases.text: The AI reads the company’s sales invoices marked for export in Saldeo, including their dates, contractor details, line items and amounts.

useCases.title: Inspect bank statement entries
useCases.text: The AI reads a company’s bank statements with their entries, contractors and links to help you review the recorded banking activity.
